title: Check: Arc Length and Sector Area

questions.stem: A sector has an area of $12\pi\text{ cm}^2$ and a radius of $6\text{ cm}$. What is the angle of the sector?
questions.explanation: $A = \frac{\theta}{360} \times \pi r^2$, so $12\pi = \frac{\theta}{360} \times 36\pi$. Dividing both sides by $\pi$: $12 = \frac{36\theta}{360}$, so $\theta = \frac{12 \times 360}{36} = 120°$.

questions.stem: What is the perimeter of a sector with radius $8\text{ cm}$ and angle $45°$? Give your answer in terms of $\pi$.
questions.explanation: Arc length $= \frac{45}{360} \times 2\pi \times 8 = \frac{1}{8} \times 16\pi = 2\pi\text{ cm}$. The perimeter includes the arc and two radii: $2\pi + 8 + 8 = (2\pi + 16)\text{ cm}$.

questions.stem: A sector with angle $60°$ is cut from a circle of radius $r$. What fraction of the full circle's area does this sector represent?
